verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills/plugin pack, so an official CLI of its own is a fair thing to ask about, but the evidence shows none. Installation and use go through host harness CLIs (Claude Code `/plugin`, `devin plugins install`, Codex/Gemini CLI) and the third-party `npx skills add` installer. Its slash commands run inside the host agent. These are host-platform capabilities, not a Superpowers CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
